## Frequently asked questions

### Where is ABS Music School & Activity?
No. 63, Naidu Shop Street, Lakshmi Nagar, Chromepet, Chennai 600044.

### What facilities does ABS Music School & Activity have?
Keyboard, Piano, Classical guitar, Acoustic guitar, Electric guitar, Singing, Music theory, Group classes, One-to-one classes, Online classes, Kids, adults & senior citizens, Open Mon–Sun, 8 am–9 pm.

### What instruments can students learn?
Keyboard, acoustic guitar, piano, singing, music theory, electric guitar and classical guitar.

### Do you take online music classes?
Yes, we offer both online and in-person music classes.

### Group classes or one-to-one?
One-on-one classes suit students from Grade 3 and above; beginners may prefer group classes.

### How do I join ABS Music School & Activity?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 87774 51087.
